facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim found an old map. 🗺️ The map showed treasure. But the map held danger too. "The map promised adventure."
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim Hawkins lived at his father's inn. A strange old sailor came to stay. When the sailor died, Jim found a map in his chest. 🗺️ The map showed a faraway island with buried treasure. "The map promised adventure." But the map also held great danger.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Jim Hawkins was an ordinary boy who lived at his father's small inn by the sea. One day, a mysterious old sailor arrived and stayed at the inn. The sailor seemed frightened, as if someone was chasing him. When the sailor suddenly died, Jim discovered a worn-out map hidden inside his chest. 🗺️ "The map promised adventure." However, Jim did not realize that this map would bring both excitement and terrible danger. Because of this discovery, Jim's quiet life was about to change forever. The adventure of a lifetime was just beginning!
facts.Word cards: map = 지도 / danger = 위험 / treasure = 보물 / inn = 여관 (옛날식 작은 숙소) / adventure = 모험
